## 7 — Oriented VGP projections (added 2026-09)
Equal-area stereonets of the reconstructed ChRM directions (before vs after per-core
azimuth + lab-flip) and the VGP polar equal-area projection. Built by
`age_model_assessment/orientation/vgp_stereonet.py` (which uses the reconstruction in
`orient.py`). Reconstructed directions collapse onto the GAD normal/reversed directions;
normal VGPs plot toward the N pole, reversed toward the S pole.

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, matplotlib.image as mpimg
for p in ["age_model_assessment/orientation/fig_stereonet_dirs.png",
          "age_model_assessment/orientation/fig_vgp_polar.png",
          "paper/figs/fig_stereonet_dirs.png","paper/figs/fig_vgp_polar.png"]:
    import os
    if os.path.exists(p):
        img=mpimg.imread(p); fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,10 if "stereonet" in p else 5.5))
        ax.imshow(img); ax.axis("off"); plt.show()
